## Assessment and Plan

The following list includes any diagnoses that were discussed at your visit.

1. Postoperative visit

> Patient presents s/p robotic right inguinal hernia repair with mesh on [DATE].
> -doing well, normal post op recovery, no acute issues
> -okay to return to activity & guide themselves based on pain
> -counseled regarding seroma formation, recommended warm compresses/heating pad
> & compression, may take up to 90 days to resolve
> -motrin or tylenol if needed for pain control, no narcotics necessary
> -follow up at 1 year post op, call with any questions/issues
